title: Prime Minister lauds National HPV Vaccination campaign
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi lauded National HPV Vaccination campaign as it achieves historic milestone of crossing 1 crore HPV vaccine doses, in less than nine months, covering nearly 87% of annual cohort of eligible girls. Shri Modi remarked that this achievement marks an important step towards building a healthier future for India's daughters through preventive healthcare and the milestone reflects  collective commitment and coordinated efforts of all the stakeholders who ensured the successful implementation of the campaign. Shri Modi posted on X; A significant milestone in our journey towards preventive healthcare. Every dose is a step towards protecting girls from cervical cancer and ensuring a healthier future for them. I commend all the stakeholders whose efforts have ensured this remarkable feat. A significant milestone in our journey towards preventive healthcare.

Every dose is a step towards protecting girls from cervical cancer and ensuring a healthier future for them.

I commend all the stakeholders whose efforts have ensured this remarkable feat. — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 23, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/VJ
